context: Request: how many Healthcare & Life Sciences matters involved informed consent or an IRB; list them. Rubric names 1018-00004 (Penterra), 1029-00001 (Thornwick), 1037-00002 (Solstice) plus a precision criterion (no other matter may be asserted).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; review flags the cap.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts and prints all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script: a heredoc error, two timeouts, then five parallel matter-number ranges printing every match (up to about 650K chars per range).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Narrower rescan: one timeout, five range runs that fail on a cut delimiter, then five that print the hit matters per range (22 candidates).

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists name-filtered files (first 15 each) of 16 shortlisted matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Twelve opening reads across the shortlisted matters, four single reads (one guessed path missing) and two per-matter rescans.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a count of five matters with reasoning and source paths. Review flags possible under-inclusion.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: A read outside any open stage is rejected; inside the stage it rereads one excluded matter's memo, rereads the response and checks cited paths (first attempt looks in a location without the file).

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It found and cited all three qualifying matters, but counted two more matters of the same client as qualifying after reading their diligence and engagement documents.

first_error.why: The answer counts two further matters as qualifying on the strength of diligence and know-how documents that mention the terms (evidence seen at [54]-[80]), although they do not qualify.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The screening review said a single document per matter was often used to settle inclusion; the write review warned only of under-inclusion. The set was not changed.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; review flags the cap.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts matters and files and prints the first twenty folder names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out; a range-chunked rerun writes hits to a file, then greps and a filter script print them (about 535K chars).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Exact-phrase rescan over all folders: 297 hit files in 129 matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script, continued. Opening reads of engagement letters and memos of nine hit matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Greps its hit file per candidate matter, five opening reads and a snippet script; stage_end lists ten qualifying matters. Review: goal not reached, several of the ten judged from hit lines only.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Opening reads of eleven documents, one per listed matter, to back the ten.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: A read outside any open stage is rejected; then five reads of further hit matters; adds one more matter.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: declared: Screen candidate matters by reading documents (attempt 4). Groups its own hit file by matter and prints hit file paths per matter, without opening documents.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Five opening reads and two snippet scripts on further hit matters; adds two more matters to a broader count.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a direct count of eleven matters and a broader count of thirteen; a rejected stage_start for the check stage sits inside. Review flags possible under-inclusion.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response. Review: the two broader matters were not re-checked.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It found the three qualifying matters but kept adding matters whose documents merely mention the terms, ending with eleven in the direct count and two more in a broader count.

first_error.why: The answer counts eight further matters directly and two more in a broader count, on documents that mention the terms in passing (diligence, discovery, disclosure; evidence seen at [30]-[105]).
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [57] named several listed matters as judged from hit lines only; the agent read one document of each and kept them. The check review named the two broader matters as unre-checked.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; review flags the cap.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Counts and prints all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Broad store-wide extraction script; times out after about 1.9M chars. Review: goal not reached.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Narrow word-boundary scan in two batches writing hits to a file (307 lines), then lists hit matters above a number.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of six candidate matters.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: A script lists name-filtered files of every hit matter; a rejected stage_start for screening sits inside.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Seventeen opening reads across candidate matters, a grep of its hit file (stage check notice), and three single reads. Review: goal not reached.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Screen candidate matters by reading documents (attempt 2). Extraction script over the engagement and intake documents of every hit matter for sector words.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a confirmed count of five matters with reasoning; a rejected stage_start for the check stage sits inside. Review flags possible over-inclusion from keyword hits and possible under-inclusion.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, checks cited paths (first attempt looks in a location without the file) and fixes one path.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It found and cited all three qualifying matters, but also counted two matters of the same client whose diligence and engagement documents mention the terms.

first_error.why: The answer counts two further matters, an acquisition diligence matter and another matter of the same client, as qualifying (evidence seen at [42]-[72]), although they do not qualify.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review listed possible over-inclusion from keyword hits without naming matters; the check stage only verified paths.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way at the write stage: each found and cited the three qualifying matters but also counted matters whose documents only mention the terms (T0 and T2 two matters of the same client; T1 eight plus two in a broader count). The write-stage reviews mostly warned about under-inclusion (unopened surfaced matters); T0 got a generic flag about single-document inclusion decisions, T2's write review a generic over-inclusion flag, and T1's screening review named some of its extra matters (it read them and kept them); no run changed its set.
